title: बलराम के हाथ में हल क्यों है? 🌾 | देवताओं के रूप का रहस्य भाग 11
caption:
यमुना को पुकारा, और हल से खींच लिया 🌾
भागवत की कथा बताती है बलराम जी का हल उनकी शक्ति की पहचान क्यों है 🙏
आप बलराम जी को कैसे याद करते हैं? 👇
first_comment: जय बलदेव, जय श्री कृष्ण लिखें 🙏 क्या आपने बलराम जी का मंदिर देखा है? 👇
sources: Bhagavata Purana, Canto 10, ch. 65 (Balarama calls the river Yamuna, she does not come, he drags her with the tip of his plough; she appears in person and asks forgiveness) and ch. 68 (Hastinapura dragged toward the Ganga with his plough until the Kauravas apologise). The plough as his weapon is also his iconographic mark. Retellings of why he carries it differ, so the reel only says the plough became the sign of his strength. Told with 'भागवत की कथा'.
